images.name: the-switch-1
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God grins beside an old time clock showing twelve o'clock and says: "Punch in."

images.name: the-switch-2
images.joke: You know you have to train tomorrow, right?
images.alt: Friends dance with sparklers under string lights at a night party; cartoon Gravel God stands at the edge and asks: "You know you have to train tomorrow, right?"

images.name: ritual
images.alt: A dark wooden table set with red candles, a skull and a carved pentagram, seen from behind cartoon Gravel God's head. A bubble says: "Whoops wrong visual."

images.name: the-switch-3
images.joke: Back in 2010 I rode 5 hours a day.
images.alt: A man in a yellow T-shirt lounges on a grey sofa with a laptop and a beer and says: "Back in 2010 I rode 5 hours a day." Cartoon Gravel God stands at the left, listening.

images.name: the-switch-4
images.joke: THE TROUBLE IS, YOU THINK YOU HAVE TIME.
images.alt: Black-and-white night photo of a wide waterfall under the northern lights, with tiny cartoon Gravel God on the snowy edge. Glowing red text: "THE TROUBLE IS, YOU THINK YOU HAVE TIME."

images.name: the-switch-5
images.alt: Sunrise over farm fields with long rays across a paved country road; cartoon Gravel God rides toward the camera on the right.

images.name: the-switch
images.alt: Two white light switches on a wall, one off and one on; cartoon Gravel God stands between them with a shrug.
